==Purpose of template==

Display an error message. Usually, this should be indicated of a code error or problem with how a module or template is used. It should not be used for, e.g., pointing out errors in information or in references to books.

==How to use==
<pre>{{Err|msg=my message}}</pre>

==Examples==
<pre>{{Err}}</pre>
{{Err}}

<pre>{{Err|Something bad happened!}}</pre>
{{Err|Something bad happened!}}

<pre>{{Err|Something bad happened!|Link}}</pre>
{{Err|Something bad happened!|Link}}
